title: Revisiting the reactivity of carbon dioxide: from physical and chemical properties to reactive carbon capture
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,7058-7066
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00285K, Tutorial Review
Jerik Mathew Valera Lauridsen, Ji-Woong Lee
The dual nature of CO2, showing that despite its thermodynamic stability, it exhibits comparable reduction potential, electron affinity, and electrophilicity to reactive organic compounds—challenging the misconception of CO2 as an inert molecule.
